Subject: Requirement analysis
Description: Define functional and non-functional requirements for all 5 hospital modules and dashboard.

Subject: Database design
Description: Design normalized MySQL schema (admins, patients, doctors, appointments, medical_records) with FK and unique constraints.

Subject: Project architecture
Description: Configure Spring Boot 3 MVC layered package layout and Maven dependencies.

Subject: UI design
Description: Create responsive blue/white Bootstrap 5 layout, sidebar navigation, cards, and modals.

Subject: Patient registration module
Description: Implement auto-generated PAT-YYYY-XXXX IDs, validation, search, and CRUD.

Subject: Doctor management module
Description: Implement doctor profiles, specialization filter, and availability status management.

Subject: Appointment scheduling module
Description: Implement past-date rejection, unavailable doctor guard, and patient/doctor slot conflict rules.

Subject: Medical record module
Description: Implement clinical records, prescriptions, allergy notes, demo-data badge, and patient history timeline.

Subject: Dashboard implementation
Description: Build summary metrics, appointment status breakdown, and recent activity tables.

Subject: Authentication implementation
Description: Configure Spring Security, BCrypt password hashing, default admin initializer, and route protection.

Subject: Patient module unit testing
Description: JUnit 5 and Mockito tests for registration, not found, validation, update, and delete.

Subject: Doctor module unit testing
Description: JUnit 5 and Mockito tests for doctor creation, lookup, specialization search, and updates.

Subject: Appointment module unit testing
Description: JUnit 5 and Mockito tests for booking, past date rejection, doctor/patient slot conflicts, cancel, and reschedule.

Subject: Medical record module unit testing
Description: JUnit 5 and Mockito tests for creation, medical history, and nonexistent patient/doctor rejection.

Subject: Integration testing
Description: Spring Security MockMvc authentication and protected-route verification.

Subject: UI validation
Description: Verify Bootstrap client-side validation, confirmation modals, and navigation links across all 14 views.
